# Side A 0.5.21
- Sessions: a new Settings tab searches every Claude Code and Codex conversation on this Mac, by what you asked, what came back and the commands that ran. - One list: what needs you first, then your pinned conversations, then each project's, with branches under the conversation they came from. New conversations from the terminal appear within a second. - Fast: the list is there the moment the tab opens, conversations open in milliseconds, and a search hit opens right at the message. - Show or resume: a running conversation's button takes you to its terminal tab; others resume with `claude --resume` or `codex resume` in Ghostty, iTerm, Warp or Terminal. - ⌘F finds within a conversation. Pin, rename or archive conversations without touching Claude's or Codex's files. - Optional notification when a session needs you, even with Side A closed. Turn it on in Settings > General. - Soft sound effects when the account changes, a session resumes or one needs you, with a volume setting.
Also in this update, from 0.5.20:
- Faster moves at a limit: when a session hits a limit, Side A reads it from the session itself and moves its account right away, even when the usage endpoint is throttled. - Better targets: Autopilot moves to an account with room on every limit. - A limited account is checked hourly, so a limit that resets early is used. - Fixes a crash when Side A posted a notification, and `source ~/.zshrc && claude` uses the chosen account.
Thanks to brandedDaniel, whose fork found most of the 0.5.20 fixes.
macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free.
